(rule! (lambda (g)
         (let* ((h (rows g))
                (w (cols g)))
           (let* ((top-line? (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g 0 c) 2)))
                  (bot-line? (for/and ((c (range 0 w))) (= (at g (- h 1) c) 2)))
                  (left-line? (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r 0) 2)))
                  (right-line? (for/and ((r (range 0 h))) (= (at g r (- w 1)) 2)))
                  (dir (cond
                         (top-line? 'up)
                         (bot-line? 'down)
                         (left-line? 'left)
                         (right-line? 'right)))
                  (non-2-objs (filter (lambda (o) (!= (obj-color o) 2)) (objects g 0)))
                  (sorted (sort non-2-objs
                                (lambda (a b)
                                  (let ((aa (obj-bbox a))
                                        (bb (obj-bbox b)))
                                    (cond
                                      ((eq? dir 'up) (< (first aa) (first bb)))
                                      ((eq? dir 'down) (> (third aa) (third bb)))
                                      ((eq? dir 'left) (< (second aa) (second bb)))
                                      (else (> (fourth aa) (fourth bb))))))))
                  (base (cellmap g (r c v) (if (= v 2) 2 0)))
                  (occupied (make-hash))
                  (_init (for ((r (range 0 h)))
                           (for ((c (range 0 w)))
                             (when (= (at g r c) 2) (hash-set! occupied (list r c) #t))))))
             (for/fold ((out base))
               ((shape sorted))
               (let* ((cells (obj-cells shape))
                      (cells-colored (map (lambda (c)
                                            (list (first c)
                                                  (second c)
                                                  (at g (first c) (second c))))
                                          cells))
                      (slide-d (let loop
                                    ((d 0))
                                    (let* ((dr (cond
                                                 ((eq? dir 'up) (- 0 (+ d 1)))
                                                 ((eq? dir 'down) (+ d 1))
                                                 (else 0)))
                                           (dc (cond
                                                 ((eq? dir 'left) (- 0 (+ d 1)))
                                                 ((eq? dir 'right) (+ d 1))
                                                 (else 0)))
                                           (can-move (for/and ((c cells))
                                                              (let ((nr (+ (first c) dr))
                                                                    (nc (+ (second c)
                                                                           dc)))
                                                                (and
                                                                  (>= nr 0)
                                                                  (< nr h)
                                                                  (>= nc 0)
                                                                  (< nc w)
                                                                  (not (hash-has-key? occupied
                                                                                      (list nr
                                                                                            nc))))))))
                                      (cond (can-move (loop (+ d 1))) (else d)))))
                      (fdr (cond
                             ((eq? dir 'up) (- 0 slide-d))
                             ((eq? dir 'down) slide-d)
                             (else 0)))
                      (fdc (cond
                             ((eq? dir 'left) (- 0 slide-d))
                             ((eq? dir 'right) slide-d)
                             (else 0))))
                 (for/fold ((o out))
                   ((cc cells-colored))
                   (let ((nr (+ (first cc) fdr))
                         (nc (+ (second cc) fdc))
                         (col (third cc)))
                     (hash-set! occupied (list nr nc) #t)
                     (set-cell o nr nc col)))))))))
